status: Expanded arcade design proposal after the user rejected the minimal composition. Awaiting visual review; not a frozen benchmark target.
direction: Fuller Roblox arcade menus: dimensional studded plates, heavy crisp borders, illustrated category tabs, prominent selected-item showcase, larger exact Roblox display typography, and coordinated Inventory/Store screens

roles.header: Soft yellow (Cool yellow BrickColor) is the user-selected default for title bars and active category
roles.card: Grey stud surfaces across ball cards, item label bands, selected-ball details, inactive category buttons and other grey panels
roles.close: Bright red reserved for close/error controls, not broad branding surfaces
roles.text: White outlined display text; Black body text on Light stone grey copy panels
roles.selection: Match the soft-yellow header for selected card and detail outlines, active-tab border, checkmark backing and selected badge

display.style: Normal; genuine heavy display face, no synthetic bold, no wide tracking or italics
display.outline: 2.5px default dark stroke, 1.8px card labels, crisp 3px downward shadow; smaller responsive sizes and adjustable outline

interface.outline: Small copy uses Black on Light stone grey; subtle 27%-strength stud relief underneath

fontVerification.method: Read installed Roblox content/fonts/families JSON, inspected font name tables and embedded those exact local TrueType files; no external font dependency in preview

treatments: Replace palette swatches and font specimens with a complete menu composition and Inventory/Store navigation
Raised purple outer framing, soft-yellow stud header, oversize canonical menu icon and red beveled Close
Illustrated dimensional category buttons with soft-yellow selected fill and outline
All twelve canonical ball appearances; four columns on large layouts, three on narrower layouts
Gray stud card faces and label bands, yellow selected outline/check, separate blue equipped badge
Large gray stud showcase with canonical ball art, separate Axe/Blade weapon art, native kit label, description and teal Equip
Store collection spotlight plus the four existing Laser, Ray, Balloons and Parasol view/preview cards
Retain exact palette and two embedded Roblox font files; no new raster artwork
Gray surfaces remain studded; texture belongs behind artwork, not on ball spheres
scope: Shared design exploration only; no Roblox runtime source edits and no route A/B/C implementation or new gameplay
gameplay: Keep existing cyan/coral team identities and territory meaning; do not recolor gameplay by cosmetic palette.
pending: User review of the expanded composition and full-menu styling
Rendered layout and interaction checks at desktop, portrait and landscape sizes
Native Roblox texture, typography and touch-size verification
Frozen common benchmark target; Figma connectivity and benchmark setup
browserQA: JavaScript parse, markup/selector checks, exact embedded-asset identity and source-catalog checks completed. Browser preview remains unavailable under the prior URL-policy restriction; no browser, Studio or phone rendering/interaction test claimed.
contrastMethod: Calculated solid sRGB foreground/background pairs only. Gradients, raised highlights and outlines also affect rendered appearance; native Studio and phone visual approval remains pending.

brickColorReference.note: Base colors are exact BrickColor RGB values; bevel lighting and shadow tints are derived.

navigation.userConfirmed: Category tab inside Inventory; follow the in-game structure
navigation.balls: Selecting any of twelve appearances updates details and Equip; detail sits to the right on larger layouts and under the collection on narrow layouts
navigation.otherCategories: Use existing canonical icons and source copy for cosmetic previews and Fusion availability; no purchase, unlock or gameplay behavior added
navigation.store: Events and Balls retain the source offer view; Explosions and Flyers navigate to their Inventory category. Ball offers select that ball in Inventory. Flyer offers navigate to Flyer previews. Spotlight opens Balls.

layout.large: Inventory four-column collection with adjacent detail; Store four offers below an illustrated spotlight
layout.medium: Inventory three-column collection with adjacent detail
layout.narrow: Three-column collection with detail below; detail art and description form two columns; Store two-column offers
layout.small: Category navigation wraps to two columns; single-column cosmetic preview cards; stacked Store spotlight
layout.widthTarget: 1024px full menu shell with reflow to 320px
layout.outerSizing: Content height; no internal scroll or fixed outer height in inline discussion aid
